maddeler.e: صِهْرِيج or صَهْرِيج • (ṣihrīj or ṣahrīj) m (plural صَهَارِيج (ṣahārīj))
maddeler.t: From Middle Persian *čāhrēg, from [script needed] (cʾh /⁠čāh⁠/, “pit, well”) + [script needed] (lyk' /⁠rēg⁠/, “sand”), or from Middle Persian *čahrīg, from [script needed] (cʾhr /⁠čahr⁠/, “wheel”). Akin to Classical Syriac ܨܗܪܝܓ (/⁠ṣhryg⁠/, “cistern”).
